tits.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to T.I.T.S. (Twitch Integrated Throwing System) right now.

tits.connect.description: Starts connecting to T.I.T.S. It does not wait: Cuebot keeps trying in the background until it works.
tits.connect.returns: true once connecting has started (not when it is connected).

tits.throwItemByName.description: Throws an item at your model in T.I.T.S. Fails with an error when T.I.T.S. has no item with that name or is not connected.

parameters.itemName: The item's name as T.I.T.S. shows it, like "Tomato". An id works too.
parameters.delay: Optional. Seconds between throws when throwing more than one. Default 0.05.
parameters.amount: Optional. How many to throw, 1 or more. Default 1.

tits.throwItems.description: Throws items at your model in T.I.T.S., picked at random from your list. Fails with an error when one of the items is unknown.

parameters.items: The items to pick from, by name or id: a list like ["Tomato", "Pillow"], or text split with commas.
parameters.amount: Optional. How many to throw, 1 or more. Default 1.

tits.activateTriggerByName.description: Runs one of the triggers you set up in T.I.T.S., by its name. Fails with an error when T.I.T.S. is not connected.

parameters.triggerName: The trigger's name as T.I.T.S. shows it, like "Rain".

tits.activateTrigger.description: Runs one of the triggers you set up in T.I.T.S., by its id or name. Fails with an error when T.I.T.S. is not connected.

parameters.trigger: The trigger's id or name, like "Rain".

tits.getItems.description: Lists the items you can throw in T.I.T.S.
tits.getItems.returns: A list of items. Each has id and name.

tits.getTriggers.description: Lists the triggers you set up in T.I.T.S.
tits.getTriggers.returns: A list of triggers. Each has id and name.
